entry.name: fluid.jit.plotter
entry.description: An abstraction based on OpenGL that plots data in a two-dimensional graph. Similar to fluid.plotter, but more performant on large datasets.

messages.name: bgcolor
messages.description: Sets the background colour of the plotter.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: Clears the graph and all associated data and settings.

messages.name: colorscheme
messages.description: Change the colour scheme for automatic colouring via a fluid.labelset~. Options are default, cat, accent, dark, paired, tableau, R4, R3, R2, R1, random. Taken mostly from.

messages.name: highlight
messages.description: Emphasises the given identifier's points in the plot. Any number of identifiers as a list of symbols can be provided.

messages.name: highlightscale
messages.digest: Set the ratio between highlighted and normal point size
messages.description: Set the ratio between highlighted and normal point size.

messages.name: panfactor
messages.digest: Set the strengh and direction of the panning
messages.description: Set the strength of the panning action when shift-clicking and dragging. Set to a negative value to invert the direction of the panning. Defaults to 1.

messages.name: pointcolor
messages.digest: Set the color of a point
messages.description: Set the color of the point with a given identifier.

messages.name: pointsize
messages.digest: Set the size of a point
messages.description: Set the size of the point with a given identifier.

messages.name: pointsizescale
messages.digest: Set the overall size of the points
messages.description: Set the overall size of the points.

messages.name: range
messages.digest: Set the x- and y-axis ranges
messages.description: Set the x- and y-axis ranges.

messages.name: refer
messages.description: In left inlet: refer to the name of awith the coordinates to be plotted. Using the refer message with no arguments will remove the reference and clear the plotter. In right inlet: refer to the name of awith the colors to be used for the points. Using the refer message with no arguments will remove the reference and reset colors to black.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: An alias of clear. Clears the graph.

messages.name: setpoint
messages.digest: Set the position of a point
messages.description: Set the point at the given coordinates.

messages.name: shape
messages.digest: Set the shape of all points
messages.description: Modifies the shape of the points. Options are circle or square.

inlets.digest: Refer to a fluid.dataset~ or highlight points.
inlets.description: Use the refer message with the name of theto be plotted. Alternatively, use the highlight message with a list of identifiers to highlight the corresponding points in the plot.

inlets.digest: Refer to a fluid.labelset~ to be used for assigning colors to the points.
inlets.description: Use the refer message with the name of theto be used for assigning colors to the points.

outlets.description: The position of the mouse will be reported while the mouse is over the plotter and is clicking and dragging. The position is constrained to the domain of the plotter.
Reports any updates made to the plotter view while zooming.
